title: FDE Customer Discovery Lab
briefing: Run the fictional Northstar discovery role-play from the companion lesson with a peer or a recorded solo exercise. Use only synthetic examples. Produce a one-page brief, stakeholder map and domain glossary. The app records self-reported completion, not verified customer research.
objectives: Separate observed workflow evidence from assumptions.
Identify the people who own data access, acceptance and operations.
Negotiate a bounded first slice and a measurable next decision.

prediction.prompt: Which uncertainty is most likely to change the pilot scope?

steps.title: Observe one concrete task
steps.instructions: Spend ten minutes walking through one synthetic ticket from trigger to outcome. Ask about tools, delays, exceptions and evidence. Write observations separately from your interpretations.

steps.title: Map domain and decision owners
steps.instructions: Spend ten minutes naming operator, sponsor, data owner, access reviewer and operational owner. Define ten terms with examples; resolve what closed and resolved mean.

steps.title: Reveal constraints
steps.instructions: Spend ten minutes introducing unresolved production access and warranty approval requirements. Update the proposed scope without treating the original request as a commitment.

steps.title: Write the delivery brief
steps.instructions: Spend ten minutes on one user, one workflow, baseline owner, excluded actions, success measure, risks and decision date. Use the lesson template.

steps.title: Play back the decision
steps.instructions: Spend five minutes reading the brief to the peer or recording yourself. Capture corrections and name the next evidence that could change the plan.

reflectionPrompts: Which question changed your understanding most?
Which claim still lacks evidence, and who can verify it?
extensionChallenge: Repeat with a customer who has excellent data but no operator capacity for review. Explain how the workflow and scope decision change.

evidenceChecklist.label: I recorded observations separately from assumptions.
I named data, decision and operational owners.
I defined one bounded workflow and its exclusions.
I captured a baseline plan and customer playback corrections.
